lanes.title: Any development OS
lanes.required_proof: Fake-server translation, tools/JSON/SSE, cancellation, migration, routing, fallback, schema/client checks

lanes.title: Linux CPU
lanes.required_proof: Lean install, portable GGUF generation, image boot, conversion image, cold/warm rebuild evidence

lanes.title: Apple Silicon macOS
lanes.required_proof: oMLX suite and native MLX/llama.cpp/Ollama coexistence

lanes.title: Linux NVIDIA
blockers: needs a working NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi: not found on PATH)
lanes.required_proof: vLLM, SGLang, ExLlamaV3/TabbyAPI suites; llama.cpp CUDA offload/build/cache validation

lanes.title: Native Windows
lanes.required_proof: Core install, llama.cpp import/generation, Ollama bridge, shutdown/cancellation; ExLlamaV3 only if separately promoted
lanes.deferral_rule: Linux or WSL results do not satisfy this lane

lanes.title: Windows + WSL2
lanes.required_proof: Documented engine recipes and Windows-Chap-to-LewLM connectivity
lanes.deferral_rule: A Linux pass alone does not prove WSL networking

lanes.title: Chap UI, later
blockers: this lane is a manual checklist; the script never marks it complete
lanes.required_proof: End-user checklist against the same public contracts
lanes.deferral_rule: Mark UI acceptance pending, never silently complete
